title: A Day at the Museum
setting: A bright art museum with large white walls.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt)

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt)

sentences.en: Sara and Kofi visit the art museum today.
sentences.zh: 萨拉和科菲今天去参观美术馆。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) and Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) walk up the steps of a big art museum.
sentences.narration: Sara and Kofi walk up the steps of a big art museum.

sentence_targets.en: creative expression through activities such as painting, sculpture, or drawing
a building displaying objects of historical, scientific, or artistic interest

sentences.en: Sara is an artist with paint on her hands.
sentences.zh: 萨拉是一位画家，手上沾着颜料。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) stands in a bright museum hall holding a brush, her hands covered in colourful paint.
sentences.narration: Sara stands in a bright museum hall holding a brush, her hands covered in colourful paint.

sentence_targets.en: a coloured substance spread on surfaces for protection or decoration
a person who creates paintings, sculptures, or other art

sentences.en: One painting shows a tall actor on a stage.
sentences.zh: 有一幅画画的是舞台上一位高个子演员。

sentences.narration: Sara and Kofi look at a large painting on a white museum wall. the painting shows a tall actor in a costume on a theatre stage.

sentences.en: Another painting shows a band with a guitar.

sentences.narration: A large painting on a white museum wall shows a small band of musicians, one playing a guitar.
